text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m confident I can support your part-time data entry needs with accuracy, strong organization, and careful attention to detail.

In a recent project, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. I created one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports, and it reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

That experience strengthened my ability to manage data cleanly, maintain accurate records, and work efficiently with spreadsheets and databases. I’d be glad to bring that same reliability to your team and help ensure your records are entered and maintained accurately.
